title: kith-peer: add Cargo.toml deps for outbound HTTP
description:
What: Add hyper-util (client-legacy+tokio), hyper-rustls (http1+webpki-roots), http-body-util, bytes, and serde_json to kith-peer/Cargo.toml so the outbound delivery client can compile.

Algorithm:
1. Open crates/kith-peer/Cargo.toml
2. Add to [dependencies]: hyper-util with features=["client-legacy","tokio","http1"], hyper-rustls with features=["http1","webpki-roots"], http-body-util, bytes, serde_json; all using workspace version pins
3. Run: cargo check -p kith-peer
4. Run: cargo clippy -p kith-peer -- -D warnings

Defensive rules:
- Use workspace-inherited version pins; do NOT hardcode version strings
- Do NOT add reqwest or native-tls; only rustls-based HTTP
- Do NOT add tokio independently; inherit from workspace

Agent team: single Implementer I. No Tester needed (pure manifest change). Validator V runs cargo check + clippy after.

Tests: cargo check -p kith-peer compiles cleanly. No logic tests for a manifest-only bead.
